_comment: Token prices in USD per million tokens, keyed by model id (prefix match, longest wins).
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: the Agent SDK reports a `total_cost_usd` per run, computed
from its own internal rate table. Those rates are not necessarily what the endpoint
behind ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL actually bills you. The token counts are ground truth;
the dollars are whatever table you apply. So we apply this one, and it is yours to
The DeepSeek rates are official published pricing. They are ~20x cheaper than the
rates the SDK's own table applies to these models, which is the entire reason this
file exists: a run the SDK reported as $0.41 actually costs about $0.02.
DeepSeek publishes cache-miss input, cache-hit input and output, but no separate
cache-write price — cache writes bill at the cache-miss input rate, so cacheWrite
mirrors input rather than carrying Anthropic's 1.25x write premium.
`cacheRead` matters more than it looks: a typical run here reads ~200k cached tokens
against ~35k fresh input. At a 120x discount to cache-miss, that 85% of the prompt
costs almost nothing — which is why fresh input, not total tokens, drives the bill.

default.source: fallback for an unknown model — deliberately pessimistic
